units: 1 = 1 map tile; footprint centred on the origin; door +z

t_grass.note: Prairie grass, a few tufts (seed varies)

t_stubble.note: Cut canola stubble in gold rows (rows run along x)

t_path_edge.note: Path on the south half, grass on the north half (turn with yaw)

t_footpath.note: A narrow footpath through grass (runs along z)

t_bank.note: Grass bank on the north half sloping into water on the south half

t_ford.note: Shallow ford: flat stones across the water (walkable)

t_gorge_edge.note: Gorge wall: grass lip at the north edge, striped rock dropping 4 to the south (blocks)

t_gorge_corner_out.note: Gorge wall turning a corner (outside corner, lip on north and west)

t_gorge_corner_in.note: Gorge wall inside corner (grass on all but the south-east quarter)

t_gorge_floor.note: Gorge bottom: river 4 below the prairie, boulders (blocks)

t_waterfall.note: The river falling over the gorge lip (north edge water, sheet down to the floor)

t_far_bank.note: The far bank of the gorge: drier grass, scattered stones

cottage_hesper.note: Hesper's stone cottage on the rise: thatch, herb boxes, chimney (door +z, at x = -0.6)

house_a.note: Village house: stone ground floor, timber and plaster above, thatch roof

house_b.note: Village house, slate roof and blue-grey stone

house_small.note: A one-storey stone house (Abel's, the shepherd's)

mill.note: The mill: stone base, timber top, slate roof; waterwheel 'Wheel' on the south-east (turns about z)

barn.note: The common barn: red gambrel roof, big sliding doors, hay loft

grain_tower.note: Prairie grain elevator: tall wooden tower with a headhouse (about 9 high)

well.note: The village well: round stone wall, posts, small roof, crank and bucket

gate_arch.note: Stone gate arch over a 2-wide road, with a sign board ('Highstead') facing +z

rune_stone.note: The grain-share stone: a standing slab; carved lines in 'Rune_glow' (tint grey for false, gold when fixed)

fold.note: Rowan's sheep fold: dry-stone wall pen with a gap on the south side, a slate lean-to shelter

root_cellar.note: Hesper's root cellar: a turf mound with a stone door frame (door +z)

market_stall.note: Highstead market stall: plank counter, striped canvas roof, produce

bridge_broken.note: The broken gorge bridge end: two posts at the lip, snapped ropes, planks hanging down the wall (+z is the gap)

fence_rail.note: Split-rail fence, 2 long along x (posts at both ends)

fence_gate.note: A plank gate in the rail fence, 2 wide

stone_wall_2.note: A 2-long piece of dry-stone field wall

hay_stack.note: A hay stack under a little thatch cap

cart.note: A two-wheeled hand cart, empty (bed 0.6 above the ground)

cart_grain.note: The hand cart full of grain (Sharing the harvest)

signpost.note: A wooden fingerpost with two arms (Label3D on each arm)

lantern_post.note: A lantern on a wooden post (the light is '*_glow')

hen_coop.note: A small hen coop on legs, with a ramp

sigil_spot.note: A place a sigil opens: gold rune ring on the ground ('*_glow', pulse it in the game)

stepping_stones.note: Flat stepping stones for a garden path

sheep.note: A sheep (static; batch 2 animates the flock)
